newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch October cash retail sales rise 9.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch October cash retail sales rise 9.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch retail sales rose 9.9 percent in cash terms in October compared with October 1995, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
In volume terms October retail sales were 9.4 percent higher than in October 1995, the CBS added.
DUTCH RETAIL SALES Oct 96 Sep 96 Oct 95
NOTES - The CBS said Oct 1996 had one Sunday and one Monday less and one Wednesday and one Thursday more than Oct 1995.
Sept 1996 had one Friday and one Saturday less and one Sunday and one Monday more than Sept 1995.
The CBS said if the figures were adjusted to eliminate the effect of the difference in trading days, October retail sales would show a year-on-year rise of 4.5 percent in cash terms.
